fact: The World Bank (IBRD) approved on 2012-03-28 a US$58 million loan to Gabon for the Fourth Phase of the Central African Backbone Program, financing a terrestrial fibre backbone from Libreville through Franceville to the Congolese border.
system: Central African Backbone Program, Fourth Phase (CAB4), Gabon Project

fact: SPIN (Gabon) and CAMTEL (Cameroon) have signed a memorandum of understanding and a confidentiality agreement on CAB-CORRIDOR, a terrestrial interconnection between Cameroon, Gabon and the Republic of Congo over the Central African Backbone, with implementation modalities expected in October 2026; signing dates are not stated, so the document's published date is used.

Gabon and Equatorial Guinea signed a bilateral agreement on interconnection of fibre-optic networks at Mongomo on 10 November 2025, between the two countries' digital-economy ministers, reported by TechAfrica News.

Gabon's backbone company reports that the Gabonese and Equatoguinean ministers inaugurated the interconnection of the two national fibre backbones at Meyo-Kye and Ebebeyin on 10 November 2025, with tests confirming traffic exchanged.
system: Interconnexion des dorsales nationales Gabon - Guinée équatoriale (Backbone National Gabonais - Equatoguinean national fibre network)
